name: Wildfire

images.credit: Montgomery, CC BY-SA 4.0 via Wikimedia Commons

Launch.Successor: HTC Wildfire S , HTC Wildfire X

Network.Technology: Europe/Asia Pacific: HSPA/WCDMA: 900/2100 MHz (A3333) or 850/2100 MHz (A3335) or 850/1900 MHz (A3334, also called "Wildfire A"); GSM: 850/900/1800/1900 MHz

Body.Other: Proximity sensor, FM Radio, Facebook, Twitter, MS Exchange, compass, GPS, A-GPS, Google turn-by-turn navigation, Full Flash support enabled / FlashLite

Platform.Operating system: Android 2.1 (Eclair) with HTC Sense Upgradable to 2.2, 2.2.1 and 2.3 (CDMA only) via HTC or 2.3.3 and 2.3.7 via CyanogenMod7 or CyanogenMod7.2. (Stable) or Android 4.0.4 (Ice Cream Sandwich) via CyanogenMod 9. (Stable, camera working with the use of power button, No panoramic mode or built in Youtube app)

Display.Display: Original: 3.2 in TFT LCD QVGA 240 × 320 capacitive touchscreen , CDMA ver.: 3.2 in TFT LCD 256,000-color 240 × 320 capacitive touchscreen

Cameras.Rear camera: 5 Megapixel autofocus with LED flash and geotagging, autofocus
